title: Wave 4 App-To-App Coupling And Framework Identity Leak Audit
description: Read-only coupling audit (V3) for Wave 4 of the generalize-apps-onto-framework-primitives refactor. Part A: read every */plugin/rs/Cargo.toml (24+ app crates) and build the dependency graph; flag any plugin crate depending on another app's plugin/domain crate, distinguishing legitimate shared-infrastructure deps (framework/*, ui/*, vcs, protocol) from genuine app-to-app leaks. Verify reasoning/mindmap no longer depends on puzzle_2d. Part B: grep framework/**, ui/**, and dev/build tooling for hardcoded app names/ids; confirm specific earlier-flagged items are now clean (framework/core/js/index.ts DEFAULT_PLUGIN_REGISTRY, ui/js/react/index.tsx PuzzleIcon/PIECE_ICON, SurfaceKind/ComponentKind renames, framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs OS_RESOURCE_KIND_IDS, framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx per-app dynamic imports) plus a broad sweep for any other hardcoded app-id leaks. Report structured findings list.
summary: Read-only V3 coupling audit, two parts. PART A (app-to-app plugin coupling): read all 27 */plugin/rs/Cargo.toml files and built the full dependency graph. Found zero genuine app-to-app leaks — every cross-app-looking dependency (procedural→flow_core/flow_module_draw/flow_module_brep, writer→trinity_jack/trinity_ram, trinity→mathematical_graph_drawing/mathematical_geometry, s & sequence→infinite_board_port_directed_dag) traces to a crate explicitly documented via AGENTS.md as a reusable shared library/framework with its own playground app, the same pattern Wave 1 established for protocol/vcs. reasoning/mindmap/plugin/rs/Cargo.toml confirmed to depend on infinite_board_port_directed, not puzzle_2d — the Wave 3 fix held. PART B (framework/ui identity leaks): confirmed 4 of 5 previously-flagged items are now clean (DEFAULT_PLUGIN_REGISTRY gone, PuzzleIcon/PIECE_ICON/w-layout-cad-menu-* gone, SurfaceKind/ComponentKind fully generic with all 12 variants renamed, OS_RESOURCE_KIND_IDS replaced by a genuine manifest-driven RESOURCE_KIND_REGISTRY, os-shell.tsx's 5 engine sessions now route through one ENGINE_SESSION_IMPORTERS table). Found 3 real remaining leaks, reported to caller: (1) that same generic loader table's "board-2d" entry still imports @semio-tech/puzzle-2d-rs directly (self-documented in-code as "still app-hosted"); (2) framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx and framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs both hardcode deep, duplicated "s" app identity (S_HOME_APP_ID/S_PLAY_APP_ID/S_PLAY_CONTROLLER_ID/S_HOME_CONTROLLER_ID/S_PLAY_CATALOGUE_TAB_ID) driving core studio-mode/home-navigation/action-routing control flow; (3) ui/styling/vite-elements-assets.ts's generic manifest-driven tile-proxy mechanism still names all its constants/types/functions after "GisMap" specifically. No files were modified — audit only. (Note: an existing ticket REMOVE-REMAINING-APP-IDENTITY-LEAKS-FROM-SHARED-FRAMEWORK-UI-CODE appears to already target similar cleanup.)
